feeds.title: The Waiter's Academy Blog
feeds.description: Food and Beverage Service blog covers waiter training, techniques to increase your TIP, to find a better job and deal with the stress accustomed to our business. The Waiters Academy is helping new restaurant servers as well as experienced restaurant waiters to develop new skills, improve their level of restaurant service and ultimately achieve a success in life.

feeds.title: NetWaiter Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on Industry interviews, Infographics, Restaurant Management, Restaurant Marketing, Online Ordering, How to Motivate Restaurant Employees and Strategies to Increase Restaurant Sales. NetWaiter is a platform and network connecting restaurants, local customers, and industry service providers.

feeds.title: Tips from a waitress Blog
feeds.description: Are you searching for a great restaurant or bar to hang out with your friends? Let me help you with some insider tips from my years of experience as a waitress. Tips from a Waitress Blog can recommend the best spots for lunch, dinner, or even a late-night drink any day of the week.

feeds.title: Waiter Wallet Restaurant Blog
feeds.description: The Waiter Wallet Blog is the perfect blog for Restaurant Owners, Managers & Servers for all things Restaurant related. Since we invented the server book in 2009, Waiter Wallet's mission has remained the same. Make the tough job of waiting tables easier and more profitable.

feeds.title: The Bitchy Waiter
feeds.description: Darron Cardosa is The Bitchy Waiter. In 2008, he started a blog as a way to release the frustrations that come with being in the world of food service. Writing stories on the Internet about annoying customers was better than poking the annoying customers in their eyes with forks. Today, he is the voice for restaurant workers around the world, saying out loud what most people in the restaurant industry are only allowed to think.

feeds.title: Amazing Singing Waiters Blog
feeds.description: The Amazing Waiters is an internationally-renown Singing Waiter Group, based in Southern California and are available for Weddings & Private Events.

feeds.title: The Singing Waiters
feeds.description: The Singing Waiters are always singing and waiting tables, why not find out what our musical waiters have been up to in their very own news blog? The Singing Waiters offer you the perfect surprise entertainment for your event.

feeds.title: Waiter Rant
feeds.description: Funny but authoritative guide to tipping, Keep the Change. Steve Dublanica is the author of the NYT Bestseller Waiter Rant.

feeds.title: The Hungry Waitress
feeds.description: Leanna here, welcome to The Hungry Waitress! This blog has been my online home since 2016. It's where I share and archive family recipes, recipes I have created and some lessons I have learned in the kitchen. It's been my learning tool and has lifted me out of many ruts.
